additional_info.subject: Firmware update via SCB
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
We are experiencing issues when trying to update the firmware from the SCB for the chargers with ID zlusYd and 8qDDVx.
For the charger zlusYd running version 6.1.3, when initiating a Firmware Rollout, the message "Rollout is already initiated" appears, although it still gives us the option to proceed with the update.
For the charger 8qDDVx running version 7.0.5, the Firmware Rollout does not execute when initiated.
Best Regards,
Lodhar Aedo L.
SIEMENS S.A.
RC-CL SI DG CS&D
Alonso de Cordova 4580
Santiago, Chile
Mobil: +56 9 57986913
Email:lodhar.aedo@siemens.com

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0453227-DC/Si-D/CL-[Multi] F/W Update CRM:00315003036
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
We updated the charger zlusYd to version 7.0.5, but when attempting to update the firmware to version 8.0.5, the message "Rollout is already initiated" appears, even though we still have the option to proceed with the update. I'm not sure what the issue is with this charger's update process, as all other chargers in Curauma have already been successfully updated to version 8.0.5.
